-82.39250,36.32740.name: Quillen Fertility & Women's Services
-82.39250,36.32740.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Mark X. Ransom, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

76.85511,30.69754.name: AAL Biosciences Research Private Limited
76.85511,30.69754.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-4.53939,55.61394.name: Ayrshire Fertility Unit, University Hospital Crosshouse
-4.53939,55.61394.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-112.83310,49.69458.name: Lethbridge
-112.83310,49.69458.status: Probationary Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, June 2024
-112.83310,49.69458.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. A site of Canadian Food Inspection Agency. Probationary Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, June 2024. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

90.42030,23.99990.name: Bangladesh Agricultural Research Institute — Bt brinjal
90.42030,23.99990.desc: Bt brinjal was approved and grown in Bangladesh after being blocked in India, developed publicly and distributed to smallholders. It is the clearest case of an engineered crop reaching poor farmers as a public-sector product, and the reporting on whether it has helped them is contested by both sides. Mahyco developed the Cry1Ac eggplant event in India, could not release it there, and donated it to this institute, which crossed it into nine local lines with Cornell, Sathguru and USAID. Approved 30 October 2013: twenty farmers in 2014, about 27,000 by 2018.

116.42000,39.91300.name: Chinese assisted reproduction sector — NHC licensing
116.42000,39.91300.desc: China licenses fertility clinics centrally and prohibits several practices permitted elsewhere, including commercial surrogacy. It is also where He Jiankui produced the first gene-edited babies in 2018, and the response — a prison sentence and a tightened law — remains the only criminal enforcement of a germline prohibition anywhere.

77.21000,28.55000.name: National Seed Association of India
77.21000,28.55000.desc: The Indian seed industry’s association, at the centre of the fight over Bt cotton trait fees after several state governments capped seed prices by law. India is one of the few places a government has directly set what a trait may be sold for, and the argument over whether that is price control or the correction of a monopoly has run for over a decade.

38.90000,-6.44000.name: Ifakara Health Institute
38.90000,-6.44000.desc: The Tanzanian institute where the first transgenic mosquito ever made in Africa was created, in 2023, as part of a programme co-led with Imperial College London and the national medical research institute. The strain expresses antimicrobial peptides derived from frogs and honeybees in the mosquito midgut, triggered when the insect takes a blood meal, and a 2025 study reported it blocking development of the main African malaria parasite using parasites from local patients rather than laboratory strains. The order of events is what this facet needs recorded: the method was developed in London, then rebuilt in Tanzania by Tanzanian scientists trained for it, under Tanzanian institutional and national oversight. Every other gene drive programme on this map is run from the country that will not host the release.

130.40000,31.66670.name: Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories (SNBL)
130.40000,31.66670.state: Kagoshima, Japan — with Tokyo, Wakayama, the US, Europe, China and Cambodia
130.40000,31.66670.desc: Japan's first contract research organisation, with more than sixty years of work and a specialisation in non-human primate studies that is its stated competitive edge. Its published locations include a laboratory in Phnom Penh. Non-clinical contracts reached the order of tens of billions of yen with overseas orders around 39 per cent of the total, and it has been building a domestic primate breeding system precisely because the imported supply became uncertain — its own risk disclosures name potential Cambodian export restrictions. Set that beside the Chinese safety-assessment company doing the same thing and the pattern is unmistakable: when a supply chain came under legal scrutiny, the contractors did not stop using the animals; they moved to breeding their own. The firm has also had Animal Welfare Act violations recorded at a US site.
